# FigmaDS Agent — Project-Wide Copilot Instructions

## Project Purpose
This workspace contains the **FigmaDS** system — a custom Copilot agent pipeline that:
1. Connects to Figma via REST API to pull design tokens (colors, typography, spacing, borders, elevation, opacity)
2. Detects file version changes to avoid redundant syncs
3. Converts tokens using Style Dictionary into Kotlin Jetpack Compose objects
4. Automatically creates or updates `.kt` foundation files in the Android project

## Workspace Layout
```
CustomAgent/
  .github/agents/        ← Copilot agent definitions (figma-ds, figma-connect, version-check, token-convert, foundation-sync)
  scripts/
    figma/               ← Figma API scripts (fetchTokens.js, checkVersion.js, saveVersion.js)
    style-dictionary/    ← SD pipeline (build.js, config.js, transforms/)
    android/             ← Kotlin file writer (writeFoundation.js)
  tokens/
    raw/                 ← Raw Figma JSON output (gitignored, runtime only)
    converted/           ← Normalized Style Dictionary input JSON
    build/android/       ← Style Dictionary output (gitignored, runtime only)
  .version-cache.json    ← Tracks last-seen Figma file version (gitignored)
  .env                   ← FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN + FIGMA_FILE_KEY (gitignored — never commit)

AndroidApp/FigmaDS/app/src/main/java/com/gajendrakarn/figmadsapp/
  foundations/           ← AUTO-GENERATED Kotlin Compose token files (Colors.kt, Typography.kt, etc.)
  components/            ← MANUAL Kotlin Compose components (Button.kt, etc.)
```

## Agent Pipeline (invoked via @figma-ds in Copilot chat)
```
@figma-ds (orchestrator)
  ↓
@figma-connect  → scripts/figma/fetchTokens.js       → tokens/raw/figma-tokens.json
  ↓
@version-check  → scripts/figma/checkVersion.js      → .version-cache.json (compare, exit if NO_CHANGE)
  ↓
@token-convert  → scripts/style-dictionary/build.js  → tokens/build/android/*.json
  ↓
@foundation-sync→ scripts/android/writeFoundation.js → foundations/*.kt  +  saveVersion.js
```

## Key Technical Decisions
- **Figma auth**: Personal Access Token via `FIGMA_ACCESS_TOKEN` env var (`X-Figma-Token` header)
- **Figma data source**: Variables API (`/v1/files/:key/variables/local`) primary; Styles API fallback
- **Version tracking**: Poll `version` field from `/v1/files/:key/meta`; cache in `.version-cache.json`
- **Android output**: Jetpack Compose only — `Color()`, `TextStyle()`, `TextUnit`, `Dp` etc.
- **Token categories**: Colors, Typography, Spacing/Dimensions, Borders, Elevation, Opacity
- **Generated file pattern**: Each `foundations/*.kt` file contains a `// <figma-ds:generated>` block that is auto-replaced; code outside that block is preserved

## Generated Kotlin Pattern
```kotlin
package com.gajendrakarn.figmadsapp.foundations
import androidx.compose.ui.graphics.Color

// AUTO-GENERATED by FigmaDS agent. Do not edit the generated block manually.
// <figma-ds:generated version="1234" updated="2026-05-11T10:00:00Z">
object FigmaColors {
    val Primary = Color(0xFF007AFF)
}
// </figma-ds:generated>
```

## Rules for Agents
- Always log progress with `[tick]` markers so users see the pipeline advancing
- Never hardcode credential values — always read from `process.env`
- Never overwrite code outside `<figma-ds:generated>` markers in foundation files
- Always validate Figma API responses before writing files (check `status === 200`, `error === false`)
- Style Dictionary must be run from the `CustomAgent/` directory root
- Use ES module syntax (`import`/`export`) throughout — `"type": "module"` is set in package.json

## Copilot Coding Standards (this project)
- Node.js ≥ 18; use native `fetch` where possible, fall back to `axios`
- Prefer `async/await` over `.then()` chains
- Validate at system boundaries (env vars missing → throw with helpful message; API errors → log + throw)
- Do NOT add speculative error handling for internal paths that can't fail
